procedure.NEW_sites: Select C02-A: A is a perceived supported local pose within 120 feet and caster line of effect on the actual current plane. Missing endpoints are a whole-case hold/preflight rejection, not a license to populate the registry from schematic tests.

procedure.NEW_lifecycle: Select C06-A: local suppression of B disables A→B and B→C, leaving C→A only if both endpoints remain valid. Never reconnect A→C.
